title: Tennessee Code Title 65, Chapter 32 - Utilities' Cut-off Procedures Act
verified_how: expanded the register's table of contents: 'Title 65 Public Utilities and Carriers' expands to 37 chapter entries, among them 'Chapter 32 Utilities' Cut-off Procedures Act', 'Chapter 33 Installment Payment of Fuel Bills', 'Chapter 4 Regulation of Public Utilities by Commission' and 'Chapter 5 Regulation of Rates', none marked; the TOC prints '[Reserved]' on siblings ('Chapter 16 [Reserved]', 'Chapter 23 [Reserved]', 'Chapter 24 [Reserved]'), so the marker is in use in this subtree. notes: Chosen because it is the consumer-facing billing statute: what a utility must do before cutting off service for non-payment, notice, and protected circumstances. A human encoding tariffs and rate-setting rather than the billing relationship should take Title 65, Chapter 5 (Regulation of Rates) or Chapter 4 (Regulation of Public Utilities by Commission) instead; Chapter 33 (Installment Payment of Fuel Bills) is the companion instalment-plan provision.
